narr: Monsoon moisture and hot temperatures fueled scattered thunderstorms over northwest Arizona. A few storms produced severe weather and flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding in the Pine Lake community left some rural roads impassable.

Very heavy rain in the mountains above Littlefield flowed down into the community, leaving the Farm/Fleet Rd underpass under I-15 flooded with approximately 10 feet of water. Other roads in the area were also flooded, including the northbound lanes of I-15 near mile marker 9.
lsr: Flash Flooding Reported by Fire Department in Pine Lake community. Some rural roadways in the area impassable.
